question_text: To qualify for the DILG Seal of Good Local Governance, a local government unit (LGU) must satisfy all of the following conditions: (1) Full disclosure of financial documents, (2) No adverse COA audit opinion for the past two years, (3) Compliance with the Full Disclosure Policy, and (4) At least 85% local revenue collection efficiency. Which of the following LGUs qualifies for the seal?

options.text: LGU A: Full disclosure, no adverse COA opinion, compliance with FDP, 90% revenue efficiency.
LGU B: Full disclosure, adverse COA opinion in one of the past two years, compliance with FDP, 88% revenue efficiency.
LGU C: Full disclosure, no adverse COA opinion, non-compliance with FDP, 92% revenue efficiency.
LGU D: Partial disclosure, no adverse COA opinion, compliance with FDP, 86% revenue efficiency.
